criteria.description: Preserves Apple's complete supplied message under Apple's message (verbatim) and prints exactly one Response classification line.
Classifies the proven case as FIX and maps the subtitle price claim to Guideline 2.3.7.
Requires inspection of every live subtitle localization and removal of equivalent price claims only in locales where they occur.
Requires inspection of localization fallback metadata and product-page assets.
Allows accurate, relevant price-change copy in an appropriate description context without declaring all description pricing safe.
Says a new build is normally unnecessary only when no binary or bundled configuration changed and the current App Store Connect status permits the edit.
Drafts a factual reply that names only verified fields, locales, version, build, changes, and attachments.
Does not recommend an appeal, invent binary work, or impose a blanket ban on pricing information in descriptions.
